title: AI data giant Alation confirms cyberattack
slides: Alation confirmed a cyberattack, but how severe is it?
The attack hit their cloud platform, not just internal systems.
Customer data may be exposed, though they haven't confirmed exactly.
Your Alation instance could be compromised—check logs now.
Action today: rotate credentials and review access immediately.
thread_text:
1. Your Alation may be breached

Customer data could be exposed—your instance might be compromised. Check logs now.

2. Attack hit cloud, not just internal

The breach targeted Alation's cloud platform, not just their own systems, widening the risk surface.

3. Data exposure unconfirmed

Alation hasn't disclosed exactly which customer data was affected, leaving you in the dark.

4. Act now: rotate credentials

Assume exposure and rotate all credentials immediately. Review access logs for unusual activity.

5. Is your data safe?

If you use Alation, verify no unauthorized access today. Ignoring this could be costly.

instagram.caption:
Your Alation instance may already be compromised. 🔍  

The cyberattack hit Alation's cloud platform—not just their internal systems—which means the risk reaches every customer using it. They've confirmed the breach but haven't said exactly which customer data was exposed, so you're still in the dark.  

For anyone managing data workflows through Alation, this isn't abstract: your access logs could show unauthorized activity right now, and your credentials may already be in the wrong hands. 🔐  

Have you checked your logs since the announcement? If not, rotate every credential and review access today—assuming exposure is the only safe move. ⏳
